opportunities.title: Correct PFAS degradation tests for losses to container walls
opportunities.one_line: PFAS sorption to containers biases degradation results; your oxidation work could quantify it.

claims.text: PFAS transfer to container walls during sampling, storage or experiments is an important source of error in PFAS analysis.

evidence_refs.quote: Mass transfer of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) to container walls during sample collection and storage or experimentation is an important source of error in PFAS analysis.

claims.text: Data that justify the usual polyethylene and polypropylene container choices are sparse.

evidence_refs.quote: However, there is sparse data to justify these container polymer choices.
To minimize this error, high-density polyethylene (HDPE) and polypropylene containers are widely used for PFAS studies.

claims.text: You have studied how PFAS structure affects oxidation in a boron-doped diamond electrochemical system.

evidence_refs.quote: Structural dependence of PFAS oxidation in a boron doped diamond-electrochemical system

opportunities.title: Magnetic iron-oxide wood as a recoverable photocatalyst support for PFAS degradation
opportunities.one_line: Magnetic wood scaffolds could hold your iron-oxide photocatalysts and be recovered after treatment.

claims.text: Porous wood has been used as a lightweight scaffold for magnetic iron oxide nanoparticles grown in situ.

evidence_refs.quote: hierarchical and porous structured wood is used as the lightweight three‐dimensional organic scaffold for the incorporation of magnetic iron oxide nanoparticles

claims.text: You have developed hybrid graphenic and iron oxide photocatalysts for the decomposition of synthetic chemicals.

evidence_refs.quote: Hybrid graphenic and iron oxide photocatalysts for the decomposition of synthetic chemicals

claims.text: Your Fe3O4/GO, ZnO and TiO2 thin films removed tetracycline photocatalytically under UV LED, blue LED and solar light.

evidence_refs.quote: Fe3O4/GO, ZnO, and TiO2 thin films for efficient photocatalytic removal of tetracycline from aqueous media under UV LED, blue LED and solar radiation

next_steps: Grow iron-oxide photocatalysts in delignified wood blocks
Test magnetic recovery and activity over several PFAS cycles

opportunities.title: Conductive wood electrodes for electrochemical PFAS oxidation
opportunities.one_line: Conductive wood could be a low-cost electrode for the PFAS oxidation you studied on boron-doped diamond.

claims.text: Conductive wood has been made as a structural material with a load-bearing function.

evidence_refs.quote: Here, we develop a conductive wood as a new type of structural electromagnetic interference (EMI) shielding material with combined load-bearing function

claims.text: Metals and carbon-based compounds are the traditional conductor choices for shielding, flexible electronics and energy storage.

evidence_refs.quote: Electric conductors are ubiquitously used for electromagnetic shielding, flexible electronics, and energy storage, with metals and carbon-based compounds as traditional choices for these applications.
